$comment: Registered ids, fixture geometry and fixed positions (user decision 2026-09-19). Single source for the plan schema enums, the MuJoCo scene and the id list sent to the understanding layer. Base frame: x forward, y left, z up, metres. Table = z 0 plane. home_xyz_m = where an object rests at the start of a run and after every reset (2026-09-19: moved off the y = 0 line by 20 mm each so that the moving jaw, which opens radially, does not touch the other cube; measured 7.2 mm displacement of blue_cube at y = 0). trials_0b keeps its own start_xy_m. 2026-09-20 (tray layout decision): destinations moved from (0.19, +-0.085) to (0.22, +-0.09), the far corners of the work area, so that the G1 start positions can vary per trial; home, work area, criteria and contact settings unchanged.
